name: Kugajima Mitsuki
source:
Individualistic asocial type.
Reason for wanting to die: Abhorrence of old farts.
Lingering attachment to this world: Revenge.

A short-tempered and emotionally unstable second-year student who seems to be deep in subcultures and hasn’t joined any club. He tends to be very aggressive but is actually a very honest person who can’t hide anything. Has a strong ego and snaps at anyone around him if he doesn’t like them. 

However, he deems any kind of prejudice as irrational and seems to harbour a deep hatred for it. Slightly hyperactive, gets worked up very easily and it’s hard for him to cool down. He’s aware that he can get carried away by violent emotions and is not rational sometimes.

A cosplayer who writes self-insert fanfics of his favourite character on top of having meltdowns over them. Being the fourth of seven siblings in a single-mother household, he lives with his mother and siblings.

[Adapted from [url=http://clubsuicide.net]the official website[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/_MORPATH?s=20&t=j3Xffhv5h-Yo19sJry3tvA]Twitter[/url].]
